t: ESP32 kits with sensors and 34 Arduino projects from blinking LEDs to a smart home.
steps: Check the model number and the project list on the Keyestudio documentation site.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE with ESP32 board support.
Download the tutorial and the libraries.
Connect the board with a USB cable and upload the first LED project.
Add batteries. The FKS0001 kit does not include them.
Plan the WiFi projects for the last lessons.
